lead.title: llama.cpp hits v1.0.0 with a stable-API promise
lead.summary: The default inference engine of the local-AI world committed to semantic versioning on Nov 13, retiring 35 deprecated functions and reserving breaking C-API/ABI changes for major-version bumps. The release adds FP8 KV caches, a host-memory MoE expert cache, new architectures (Kimi-K3.1-Pro, Ripple, xing4_0), drama-3 TTS with a /v1/audio/speech endpoint, a hardened llama-server (SSRF, CORS, DNS-rebinding defenses, MCP tool cancellation), a redesigned web UI, a native macOS app, and official Docker, Debian, Homebrew, conda-forge, MacPorts, Winget and XCFramework channels. The r/LocalLLaMA announcement drew roughly 1,500 upvotes in a day.

top_stories.title: Baidu ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview: 280B MoE with 1M-token context, open weights expected before Nov 25
top_stories.summary: A 280B-parameter (14B active) MoE tuned for long-running agent tasks is free on OpenRouter now, with open weights promised before Nov 25.

top_stories.title: Mirendil raises $1B to speed up AI model development
top_stories.summary: A $1B Series A co-led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake, with Google participating, for agentic AI that automates frontier model training runs.

top_stories.title: Jensen Huang's departure blasts a hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
top_stories.summary: Nvidia wrote into 105 AI startup rounds this year, often as the largest investor; smaller, more selective checks under the successor are expected to deflate valuations, especially in Europe.

top_stories.title: Ars Technica reviews the M6 iMac: a capable local-AI desktop with a dual 16-core Neural Engine
top_stories.summary: 15-20% faster single-core, 20-40% faster graphics and per-core Neural Accelerators make the $1,499 iMac viable for small-to-mid local models, though 32GB and 170 GB/s bandwidth cap generation speed.

items.title: SoScale: second-order scale search for FP4 quantization
items.summary: Searches hardware-valid scale codes for MXFP4/NVFP4/HiF4 block formats under a Hessian-aware layer-output objective instead of default max-abs scaling, targeting FP4's accuracy loss on LLMs.

items.title: Metal Sandbox: isolated GPU coding agents on Apple Silicon
items.summary: Per-instance file isolation, native command execution and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs so parallel agent commands run concurrently and migrate between nodes.

items.title: Reasoning supervision and capability retention in LoRA domain adaptation
items.summary: Ablations of Qwen3-8B LoRA fine-tuning on financial data show response-only LoRA improves in-domain performance while leaving general capabilities near baseline.

items.title: Wanda-guided sparse perturbations for cheaper zeroth-order fine-tuning
items.summary: WIS-MeZO uses Wanda weight-activation saliency to build sparse perturbation masks for forward-only fine-tuning, beating MeZO across 16 benchmarks on 3B-32B LLaMA and Qwen models.

items.title: Edge0 open-sources Edge0-145B: a latent-sparse MoE agent model built to run on a laptop
items.summary: Billed as the first open model aimed at personal-computer agents rather than datacenter serving: 10.12B active of 145B, 512 experts/layer, 256K context, a 40.81 GiB Q3_K checkpoint, and claimed ~29GB peak memory with 121 tok/s agent decode on an RTX 5090 24GB — though benchmarks are mostly Edge0's own evals.

items.title: Salesforce SOV-Transcribe-1 becomes the #1 open-weight speech-to-text model
items.summary: A 26B-total/4B-active Apache-2.0 ASR model claiming 2.28% WER on the AA-WER index — top of the open-weight rankings as of Nov 12 — with style steering, context biasing and strong entity handling for local voice stacks.

items.title: Meta publishes facebook/meta-encoder-v1 with open weights
items.summary: Meta's newest encoder lands with a public Hugging Face repo, relevant for local embedding and retrieval pipelines; details are thin at launch.

items.title: ModelMesh shards models across Macs via Llama-RPC, from a native macOS app
items.summary: Distributes model weights across multiple Apple Silicon Macs using llama.cpp's Llama-RPC to run models larger than any single machine's unified memory — no command-line setup.

items.title: Browserr: an MCP-first browser for AI agents in one Rust binary
items.summary: A single-binary browser designed to be driven by agents through MCP as its primary interface rather than a human UI.

items.title: Memro adds persistent memory shared across Claude Code, Cursor and Codex
items.summary: Open-source memory layer so coding-agent context survives across sessions and tools.

items.title: CtxWise trims MCP schema bloat that crashes agents and busts prompt caches
items.summary: Open-source tool that cuts oversized MCP tool schemas and context payloads to prevent crashes and cache misses in agent setups.

items.title: n8n adds per-API-key public API rate limits, on every edition from 2.47.0
items.summary: Admins can cap read/write requests per API key globally and per endpoint, with Retry-After headers and Redis-shared counts across multi-main setups — off by default, configurable via env vars.

items.title: Weight-space programming applied to GGUF quants: up to 2x better KL divergence on Qwen models
items.summary: An r/LocalLLaMA thread reports Nace quants with up to 2x lower KL divergence than standard quants across Qwen 9B/27B/35B and Flash Next at comparable file sizes — a practical option for VRAM-constrained rigs if it holds up.

items.title: MoEShift runs large MoE models on Apple Silicon Macs with as little as 10GB RAM
items.summary: An alpha backend using SSD offloading, lookahead expert scheduling and a protected expert cache hit 10.44 tok/s generation on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B on a 24GB Mac mini M4 Pro at 6.4GB peak memory.

items.title: AMD gaming GPU supply reportedly falls 20-50% in China
items.summary: A board-channels claim relayed by VideoCardz says monthly China allocations dropped since October, with tight supply through January 2027; AMD has not confirmed it.

items.title: ASUS unveils Gallop, a humanoid robot running a single Jetson AGX Thor
items.summary: Trained on factory footage, simulation and VR teleoperation, Gallop is already packing parts on an ASUS line; commercial availability is planned for H2 2028.
